effect_description_eng:
When one of your [Paildramon] or [Dinobeemon] would digivolve into this card in your hand, reduce the memory cost of the digivolution by 2.
＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.)
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon deletes an opponent's Digimon in battle and survives, unsuspend this Digimon.
